commercial_invoice_pi_not_persisting.note: Client reported: in the Logistics module (Shipment), the selected Proforma Invoice (پیش‌فاکتور) on the Commercial Invoice tab does not persist after saving.
commercial_invoice_pi_not_persisting.status: Root cause: the Commercial Invoice tab's fields are all ->dehydrated(false), and the tab had its OWN separate 'Save Invoice' footer action, entirely disconnected from the Shipment record's normal Save button — a user filling the tab then clicking the NORMAL Save button silently lost the selection. Fixed by moving Save/Download/Restore CI out of the schema-level footerActions() (app/Filament/Resources/Operational/ShipmentResource/Traits/InvoiceForm.php) and into EditShipment::getFormActions() (app/Filament/Resources/Operational/ShipmentResource/Pages/EditShipment.php), sitting directly beside — and preceding, for accent — the record's own Save/Cancel buttons, reading the page's live $this->data array instead of a schema Get closure. persistInvoiceToEav() signature changed from (Get $get, $record) to (array $formData, $record) to support this. All three CI actions are disabled via blank($this->data['_inv_pi_id'] ?? null) until a Proforma Invoice is actually selected. A third action, 'Restore CI', was added — reverts unsaved in-progress edits back to the last saved EAV state (or blanks the tab if nothing was ever saved) via a new shared EditShipment::hydrateInvoiceData() + $this->form->fill(). The 'Download CI' action's persist-then-open-PDF race (action + ->url()->openUrlInNewTab() could open the PDF before the AJAX save finished) was fixed by dropping ->url() and opening the tab via $this->js('window.open(...)') only after persistInvoiceToEav() completes. The Notes card was also relocated from the right column to the left column, directly under the Items/products section, per user request. Verified via tests/Feature/Filament/ShipmentResourceTest.php (5 passed, including a Livewire::test(...)->callAction(TestAction::make('saveInvoice')->schemaComponent('form-actions', 'content')) end-to-end action test — see testPattern.md §3e for why page-level getFormActions() actions need schemaComponent() targeting) and a claude-reviewer pass.

Known gap: this new renderer only covers EntityAttributeResource's own infolist/table — the OTHER EAV entry point (HasExtraAttributesManagement's inline Repeater tab on the owning resource, e.g. Shipment's own Extra Attributes tab) still uses the older flat formatter; not in scope unless the user asks for it there too.

L03_sort_pagination.note: User: sorting the list crashed with SQLSTATE[42S22]: Unknown column 'recipient'.
L03_sort_pagination.status: fixed — showRecipients()'s TextColumn::make('recipient.*.name') was ->sortable() with no custom query; 'recipient' is a model accessor (reads settings->users), not a real column, so Filament's default sort built an invalid json_extract(`recipient`, ...) against a column that doesn't exist. Reproduced the exact crash via a real Livewire sortTable() call first, then removed ->sortable() from that column — recipients aren't a real sortable column and there's no clean query-level equivalent (the underlying data is a JSON array of user ids, not a joinable relation).

C02_create_validation.note: User: an empty form submission successfully creates a meaningless notification rule.
C02_create_validation.status: fixed — added ->required() + validationMessages() to the three fields a rule can't do without (notification_type, settings.tables, settings.actions); column/value selectors stay optional since they're conditionally hidden until an 'update' action is picked. New validation_required lang key added in all 3 locales.

V01_validation_i18n_leak.note: 2026-10-07 exhaustive validation-i18n audit (separate from C02 above, which only covered 'required'): notification_type (single Select) and settings.actions/settings.columns/settings.values/settings.tables/settings.users (multi Selects) all still leaked raw English on an invalid selection, since only the 'required' key had been wired, never 'in'/'*.in'.
V01_validation_i18n_leak.status: fixed — wired 'in' on notification_type and '*.in' on all 5 multi Selects with a new shared validation_in key; regression tests test_create_action_rejects_an_invalid_notification_channel_with_translated_message and ..._invalid_actions_... added to a new NotificationSettingResourceTest.php (none of the earlier C02/N01/etc fixes above had a dedicated Filament resource test file yet).

P01_role_permissions.note: User: any authenticated user could delete any other user's notification setting — no role gating and no ownership check at all.
P01_role_permissions.status: fixed, final shape settled same day after a revert. First attempt: wired HasResourcePermissions (role-gated view/create/edit/delete/restore) plus the ownership check layered on top of role-delete. User explicitly reverted the role-gating part — 'all users must be able to use them, only user who create or recipient of notification only must be able to delete it' — view/create/edit/restore must stay open to any authenticated user, no Spatie permission at all. Final: HasResourcePermissions removed from the resource entirely, notification_setting.* permission rows removed from both DatabaseSeeder.php and the live DB (none exist anymore); getDeleteAuthorizationResponse()/canDelete() stay as a standalone ownership-only override (creator or settings->users recipient), independent of any role. Bulk delete keeps the same per-record filtering via ->authorizeIndividualRecords() on the DeleteBulkAction. tests/Feature/Integrity/ResourceAuthorizationIntegrityTest.php's now-unnecessary allowlist entry for this resource was removed too (it no longer composes the trait, so the integrity check skips it).
